CENTRAL PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Appointment as the Chairman
of the Road Development Authority, under the Central Province Road Development
Authority Statute No. 2 of 2003 of the Central Provincial Council

I, Ediriweera Weerawardhana, Minister of Road Development, Transport, Power and Energy, Housing and Construction of theCentral Provincial Council give notice under the powers vested in me by the paragraphs No. 03 (1) and (2) of the StatuteNo. 2 of 2003 of Central Province Road Development Authority of the Central Provincial Council , appoint Mr. P. W. M. PalithaSirisena of No. 114/A, Barigama Road, Pallegama, Halloluwa as the Chairman of the Central Province Road DevelopmentAuthority of the Central Provincial Council with effect from 19th April 2018.
EDIRIWEERA WEERAWARDHANA,Minister of Road Development, TransportPower and Energy, Housing and ConstructionCentral Province.

CENTRAL PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Dissolving of the appointment as the Chairman and the member
of the Director Board of the Road Development Authority, under the
Central Province Road Development
Authority Statute No. 2 of 2003 of the Central Provincial Council

I, Ediriweera Weerawardhana, Minister of Road Development, Transport, Power and Energy, Housing and Construction of theCentral Provincial Council give notice under the powers vested in me by the paragraphs No. 03 (1) and (2) of Part 1 No. 2 2003of Central Province Road Development Authority Statute and Part 1 No. 03 (1) and (3) of the Central Provincial Council,dissolve the appointment of Mr. I. W. U. Ubeypala as the Chairman / Member of the Director Board of the Central ProvinceRoad Development Authority with effect from 18th April 2018 who was appointed by me by Gazette No. 1920/ 21 dated 24thJune 2015.
EDIRIWEERA WEERAWARDHANA,Minister of Road Development, TransportPower and Energy, Housing and ConstructionCentral Province.
